bootstrap_calibration: centered stratified block-bootstrap noise is added to the fitted null model and every replicate is refitted before computing its statistic
bootstrap_hierarchy: all replicas retained as fixed strata; time blocks sampled with replacement independently within each replica

covariance_regularization.method: eigenmode truncation of the correlation matrix; retained modes have lambda > relative_threshold * lambda_max

field_interval.definition: specified from the exact half-height crossings before examining finite-size residuals

fixed_limit_fit: X_L = X_infinity_exact + B/V; B is the only fitted parameter
independence_structure: lattice sizes come from independent simulations and are treated as independent covariance blocks; observables within a size retain their full bootstrap covariance

joint_fixed_limit_models.linear_all: X_L = X_infinity_exact + B/V for all five sizes
joint_fixed_limit_models.quadratic_all: X_L = X_infinity_exact + B/V + C/V^2 for all five sizes

limitations: The centered bootstrap calibrates finite-sample noise but is not a proof of asymptotic chi-square behavior.
Covariance modes below the declared relative threshold are not assigned inverse weight.
The exact-crossfit label refers to the decomposition, not to equality of finite training and heldout estimates.
The first-corrected prediction tests the derived truncated expansion on a fixed field interval; it is not an all-orders identity.
monte_carlo_p_value: (1 + number of centered-bootstrap statistics at least as large as observed)/(B+1); the minimum reportable values are therefore 1/(B+1)

prediction_distinction.exact_crossfit: the finite-volume decomposition is algebraically exact for its training primitives; transfer to heldout replicas is a statistical cross-fitted prediction
prediction_distinction.first_corrected_logistic: fixes the exact thermodynamic density gap and cavity-work difference, fits d0,dchi,a1,dn only to training phase primitives over the specified field interval, and evaluates the derived O(1/V) curve; the total response adds its leading intraphase term
prediction_distinction.leading_logistic: uses only h=0 training primitives and additionally assumes their leading two-state field dependence
